title: Get ready with me: detention edition
situation: Influencers post "GRWM to get detained" and OOTD videos before marches; some creators criticise the trend as trivialising, others defend it as spreading the message.

lines.text: I am wearing a spine, some jhumkas and my constitutional right to oh… Never mind!
